mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, which increase the risk of QT prolongation when combined with moxifloxacin, a fluoroquinolone known to prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly; consider alternative diuretic or fluoroquinolone; perform baseline and follow-up ECG monitoring if combination is necessary.
